entities.name: Anna Jókai
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Anna Jókai was a Hungarian author, poet and teacher. She began her writing career in 1974 and, during the 1980s, she participated in the Hungarian liberation movement. Between 1990 and 1992, she was the chairperson of the Hungarian Writers' Union.
